column3: Permissions are checked at three points: inject at mount, every other Cordis service read from a plugin row through a loader internal/get hook (plus secrets.get and ops.run checking their caller), and ctx.get, computed names and cloudflare:workers imports at build in scripts/boundaries.ts; host is guarded by a new runtime permission that the eleven shipped plugins injecting it declare
column4: review of xin#19 (XIN-23) showed a row with no permissions reading a credential through ctx.get, the database through a nested ctx.inject, the raw storage and KEK through host, and running plugin.enable as the owner; ctx.get and module imports bypass Cordis hooks and the Home has no sandbox, so those are refused at build and the spec says the checks keep honest code to its declaration but do not confine hostile code
column5: src/kernel/doctor.test.ts k-reach: secret, nested inject and owner-actor reads are refused and the test fails without the guards; boundaries found plugins/orchestrator/tools.ts reading plugins undeclared (now declared)
